title: Builder-Completion Offset on Rate Lock Commitment Appraisal-Delay Waivers
content:
Where the builder has not finished the home, an offset applies to a **Rate Lock Commitment** appraisal-delay waiver. For a waiver Larkspur books on its own initiative, and only for such a waiver, an offset is subtracted from the covered days of an appraisal-delay waiver, because a home the builder has not finished holds the closing up as well. The covered days, after the subtraction, are never below zero and never more than the extension's charged days.

The basis is whether the appraisal report on the **Appraisal Order** was made subject to completion, and the status of the **Mortgage Loan File**.

**Rule.**

- When the appraisal report was made subject to completion and the loan file is not yet clear to close, the unfinished-home offset of **2** days is subtracted.
- When the report was made subject to completion and the file is clear to close, the completion offset of **1** day is subtracted.
- Otherwise nothing is subtracted.

| Report subject to completion | Loan file clear to close | Days subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 2 |
| Yes | Yes | 1 |
| No | Either | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* covered days of 1, on a report made subject to completion for a file still in underwriting, become 1 less 2. That is taken as 0, never below zero.
